title: Fed minutes: officials saw inflation risks worsening before the September hike
summary: Minutes of the 15–16 September FOMC were released on 7 October. The 25 bp hike to 3.75–4.00% was unanimous, the first since 2023, and officials flagged worsening inflation risks. Markets now focus on the 28 October decision.
ict: ICT calls interest rates the single most influential driving force. Before trusting a Dollar Index order block around CPI or FOMC, check the interest-rate triad (30-year, 10-year, 5-year futures) for a failure swing.
